ai.title: AI product content
ai.subtitle: Prepare, review and import content for each shop.
ai.settingsDescription: Content rules, category profiles, automation and processing history.
ai.setupHelp: OpenAI processing is not enabled yet. You can prepare rules after unlocking AI settings.
ai.setupInstructions: Create a separate API project and project key in OpenAI Platform. Your server administrator adds it to /opt/inventory-hub/ai-content.env, sets the Hub access token, enables AI and restarts the API as described in docs/ai-content.md.
ai.independentAccount: The API project can belong to another account. This connection does not use a ChatGPT subscription or ChatGPT project. API billing is separate.
ai.unlockHelp: Use the Hub access token configured by your server administrator. Do not enter an OpenAI API key here.
ai.rulesHelp: Rules apply in order: common → supplier → brand → category → shop → product → this preparation. Empty settings inherit. Saving creates a draft; publishing applies it to new jobs.
ai.restoreHelp: Load, compare and republish an earlier version. Existing jobs retain their original rules.
ai.parametersHelp: AI can fill only the listed parameters. Missing required evidence blocks import. Variant parameters must match the existing feed choice axes.
ai.allowedValues: Allowed values separated by | (empty = free value)
ai.proposalHelp: AI uses the published profile. It proposes instructions and optionally the category parameter registry. Proposals are never published automatically.
ai.proposalPlaceholder: What should be added or clarified?
ai.acceptProposal: Save proposal as a rule draft
ai.estimateHelp: This estimate is not an invoice or a guaranteed price. The allowance counts towards the Hub budget and is replaced by recorded usage after the response.
ai.activeAfterImport: Product will be active after import
ai.hiddenAfterImport: Product will remain hidden after import
ai.reselectPartial: Select the new variants in the catalog and prepare a separate job. Content is tied to the exact variant selection.
ai.prepareHelp: Only selected products and variants are included. AI edits the shared family content; the existing importer manages prices and identity. Each shop receives its own content and result.
ai.researchFeed: Feed only – quick processing without additional research
ai.fallbackCategory: Category when the profile has no mapping
ai.mappingPriority: Category profile mapping takes precedence over this fallback category. Switches here apply only to this preparation.
ai.automaticNotice: Processing follows the selected profiles. Disabling the estimate skips the cost pause; disabling approval and confirmation enables automatic import. Technical errors always stop import.
ai.jobPersistence: Jobs persist on the server. Removing from the list archives them; history and costs remain.
ai.noJobs: No jobs yet. Select products in a supplier catalog.

errors.upgates_update_http_400: The shop rejected the update data (HTTP 400). Review the selected fields and prepare a new comparison.
errors.upgates_update_http_401: Shop API authentication failed (HTTP 401). Check the shop connection and prepare a new comparison.
errors.upgates_update_http_403: The API lacks permission to update the selected data (HTTP 403). Check permissions and prepare a new comparison.
errors.upgates_update_http_422: The shop rejected a field value (HTTP 422). Review the data and prepare a new comparison.

errors.ai_existing_brand_mismatch: The selected brand differs from the shop manufacturer. Choose the matching brand.

errors.ai_update_stock_unknown: Shop stock could not be verified. Availability was not changed; refresh the comparison or leave it out of the update.

ai.categoryAncestorsHelp: Selected category is primary; ancestors are included automatically.
ai.nonBlockingWarnings: Content warnings – these do not block import on their own
ai.unknownImportHelp: The previous submission is unconfirmed. Reconciliation reads the shop without resending. You can archive the job.
ai.partialHelp: Select remaining variants. A new preparation uses current rules. Copied content requires review. Identity and required-data errors cannot be bypassed.
ai.copySelectedContent: Reuse AI content without another AI call
ai.updateExistingHelp: Select fields to update. Current shop data and changes appear before confirmation. Prices, stock, identifiers, URL and active state are preserved. Select the complete family.
ai.ruleOrder: Priority: common → supplier → brand → category → shop → product → this preparation
ai.noRulesInGroup: No rules in this group yet.
ai.removeRuleConfirm: Remove “{{name}}” from the draft? History is retained. Save and publish to apply.
ai.importPolicyHelp: Hub applies these values during import. Empty fields inherit supplier defaults. Supplier stock is not copied to local stock.
ai.hideZeroStock: Hide new variants with confirmed zero supplier stock

updateStates.rejected: The shop rejected the changes; fix the data and prepare a new comparison.

next.queued: Queued; can be cancelled before starting.
next.review: Edit and approve content, then review import or update.
next.blocked: Fix red errors and required missing facts before approval.
next.ready: Review and confirm import, or prepare an existing-product update.
next.completed: Done. Update selected fields or archive.
next.exists: Already in shop. Prepare a field-selected update.
next.failed: See the error; prepare another attempt or archive.
next.import_failed: See the import error below. Reconcile an unknown outcome first.
next.import_blocked: Fix import data or prepare valid variants separately.
next.uncertain: AI call outcome unknown. A paid retry needs a new preparation.

ai.updateOnlyHelp: This preparation updates an existing product. After approving the content, choose specific fields and confirm the comparison. Prices, stock, variants and product visibility are preserved.
ai.shopAvailabilityHelp: Availability is preserved for preparations from existing shop content because current supplier availability is not available here.
ai.appliedRulesHelp: These rules were saved when this preparation was created. Later rule changes are not automatically applied to it.
ai.noRegisteredParameters: This preparation has no predefined category parameter registry. AI cannot add new parameters outside the allowed registry.

updateNext.review: Review and approve the content, then choose fields to update.
updateNext.blocked: Fix the errors and missing required facts, then approve the content again.
updateNext.preparing_import: The approved content is being checked for updating the existing product.
updateNext.ready: Choose fields and prepare a comparison with the current shop content.
updateNext.exists: Content is approved. Choose fields, review the comparison and confirm the update.
updateNext.completed: Selected changes have been verified in the shop. This task can be archived.
updateNext.failed: Check the error. Create another attempt in Existing products, or archive this task.
updateNext.uncertain: The AI call result is unconfirmed. Any new paid attempt must be prepared through Existing products.

existing.code: Exact product code in the shop
existing.boundaries: An estimate is prepared first; AI starts only with Start processing. Selected text, parent parameters and categories can be updated. Prices, stock, variants and product visibility are preserved.
